title: Sign In
welcomeSubtitle: Sign in with Google to view your profile and continue.
subtitle: Sign in with Google to view and manage your profile
googleNoCredential: Google did not return a credential
googleSignInCancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled or failed
googleSignInInProgress: Google sign-in is already in progress
googlePlayServicesUnavailable: Google Play Services is not available on this device
googleNoIdToken: Google did not return an ID token. Confirm webClientId is the Web OAuth client ID (not Android/iOS client ID).
networkCannotReachServer: Cannot reach the server. Check that visamesa_be is running and API_BASE_URL is correct for your emulator.
googleBackendOAuthMisconfig: Backend OAuth misconfiguration: add GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID to visamesa_be/.env with your Android OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console, then restart the server.
googleAndroidMisconfig: Google Sign-In is misconfigured for Android. In Google Cloud Console, create an Android OAuth client for package com.visamesa with SHA-1 from ./gradlew :app:signingReport (Variant: debug). The Web client ID must stay in google.ts as webClientId.
